reuse.why: Calls the shared getRangeAmount, but the existing getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts already decides missing/number/range in one call and is not used.

duplication.why: The missing ? 0 : number ? value : getRangeAmount(range) ternary is another copy of the dispatch already inline in schedules/app.ts, forecast-schedules and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, and encapsulated in getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: Adding the derived field in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts fits the API mapping layer, though it puts a domain rule into the model mapper.

scope.why: One type field, one mapped field and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small and readable, but if the expected-amount rule changes for missing or single amounts this copy has to be found and updated separately.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal re-does getScheduledAmount's null/number/range dispatch instead of calling it.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied nested ternary is the same shape as the existing inline copies.
